scope: Five transform caller bodies and shared data dispatch; not native geometry equivalence or all transform nodes

nodes.name: Move
nodes.behavior: Missing object -> UpdateMissing. Destination minus source translation, duplicate object, invoke shared Transform, emit duplicate; return value ignored.
nodes.edgeCases: GetPoint initializes out to Point3d.Unset; failed conversion does not leave default origin. Return statuses ignored.

nodes.name: Mirror
nodes.behavior: Flatten input; defaults duplicate=false, axes=false. Valid invertible InXform conjugates world-axis scale as F*S*inverse(F); invalid/noninvertible frame falls back to identity. Duplicate=false combines enabled signs and transforms each duplicate. Duplicate=true appends each enabled-axis reflection of accumulated outputs, then each original input; originals are not directly appended.
nodes.ordering: For input [a,b], X then Y: [Xa,Xb,YXa,YXb,Ya,Yb]. For k enabled axes and n flattened inputs: (2^k-1)*n output items. Duplicate=true with no axes emits empty array; duplicate=false with no axes emits identity duplicates. Single result unwrapped, zero/many stay array.
nodes.orientation: Uses cross(transformed X,transformed Y) dot transformed Z < 0 to request Flip; helper flips only ICSFlippable. Z duplicate branch omits Flip for prior accumulated items but applies it to fresh original items. Static asymmetry only; requires original PC verification.

nodes.name: RotateObjectDeg
nodes.behavior: Degrees multiply Math.PI/180; rotations constructed via OnXform around world origin or tight bounding-box center. Matrix expression Rx*Ry*Rz. Duplicate null returns base.Update without replacing output; transform return ignored.
nodes.edgeCases: Recovered object input declared Boolean/Individual despite arbitrary data use. Missing-object message says TranslateObject. Do not silently normalize recovered declarations or assert released runtime defect. Bounds success flag ignored; invalid bounds/axis behavior needs PC oracle.

nodes.name: ScaleObject
nodes.behavior: Read x/y/z initialized to 1; world-XY nonuniform scale about origin, duplicate object then Transform, emit duplicate. Missing object -> UpdateMissing. No caller Flip even for negative determinant.
nodes.edgeCases: Zero, negative, nonfinite and failed channel conversion delegated to original channel/kernel; no newly invented clamp or orientation repair.

nodes.name: TransformObjectXform
nodes.behavior: Gather nonnull NonExpandableInputChannels, flatten; identity accumulator; for each nonnull valid transform, accumulator=value*accumulator. Invalid transforms skipped. Emit CSXformData even when no valid inputs.
nodes.edgeCases: Preserve literal NonExpandableInputChannels property usage pending expansion-base inspection; matrix multiplication/storage conventions require independent points and PC oracle, not name-based inference.

shared.transform: Reject invalid matrix and non-ICSTransformable. Invoke ApplyTransform but ignore its bool and return true. Callers also ignore Transform bool.
shared.arrays: CSDataArray.ApplyTransform visits every ICSTransformable member and returns whether any true; duplicate preserves order and replaces null members with new CSData. Flatten retains nonarray references, recursively flattens ICSArray and substitutes new CSData for null/failed flatten.
shared.flip: Shared Flip dispatches ICSFlippable; CSDataArray recursively dispatches member Flip. No extra orientation policy can be assumed.
shared.rotation: Native OnXform.Rotation copied into Rhino Transform; source alone does not validate identical backend angle/axis/bounds behavior.

requiredOracleCases: Noncommuting translations and rotations, matrix layout and multiplication action
Tight bounds origin vs object center; unset/invalid point and bound paths
All eight axis masks x both duplicate states with ordered tagged inputs
Negative/nonuniform/zero scale and flip orientation on each geometry data type
Transform false return, null duplicate, exception and previous-output retention
probeGap: Current analytical native probe tests no transform caller. Do not mark any transform feature verified.
